briefing:
إليك التقرير التكتيكي الشامل والجريء للجولة رقم 10، المصمم وفق أقصى معايير البرمجة الرياضية ومحرك القواعد الذهبية التاريخية (Hindsight Gold Rules):

---

### 1. التكتيك المعتمد وموقف الترتيب (Aggressive Rank Recovery)
* **الموقف الحالي:** الترتيب العام (10,618,666) يتطلب تفعيل استراتيجية **"الهجوم التعويضي المكثف" (AGGRESSIVE)**. الالتزام بالحلول التقليدية لن يقفز بالفريق في الترتيب؛ الهدف الآن هو اقتناص النقاط غير المباشرة (Differentials) واستغلال القيمة المرتفعة للبنك.
* **التشكيل المعتمد (3-5-2):** اعتمدنا تشكيل 3-5-2 كونه يمنح الفريق الكثافة التهديفية الأكبر في خط الوسط، وهو التشكيل الأنسب تكتيكياً لإحداث الفارق وحصد نقاط الأهداف والتمريرات الحاسمة بأعلى نسبة متوقعة.

---

### 2. مدى مطابقة القرارات للقواعد الذهبية (Gold Rules Compliance)
أظهرت قراراتنا توافقاً تاماً مع القواعد التاريخية المثبتة للنظام:
* **توزيع الميزانية (Position Allocation):** تنص القاعدة الذهبية على ضرورة منح خط الوسط الأولوية المباشرة بحصة تصل إلى **39.8%** من ميزانية التشكيل الأساسي. بتواجد خماسي قوي (Palmer, Rogers, Tavernier, Mbeumo, Hinshelwood)، نلتزم حرفياً بتعظيم العائد الرقمي من المراكز الأكثر إنتاجية.
* **شرعنة الخصم (-4 Hit):** أثبت المحرك التاريخي أن أخذ السوالب (+20 Hits عبر الموسم) كان الخيار الرياضي الأمثل لتحقيق قفزات انفجارية. التبديل لا يُقاس بالجولة الحالية فقط، بل بصافي الربح التراكمي.
* **استراتيجية الكابتن:** توافق اختيار الكابتن بنسبة **80%** مع قاعدة اختيار لاعبين بسعر متوسط (متوسط £6.5m)، حيث أثبتت البيانات التاريخية أن الكباتن غير الخارقين (Non-Premiums) يحققون فارقاً نقطياً هائلاً في جولات محددة مقارنة بسعرهم.

---

### 3. التحليل الرياضي والتكتيكي للتبديلات وتبرير الـ Hit (-4)
* **🔴 بيع Bassey ──► 🟢 شراء White (£5.4m | ARS):** 
  * *السبب التكتيكي:* بيع مدافع بسقف نقاط محدود لحساب مدافع يمتلك أعلى معدل نقاط متوقعة (xP: 6.5) في الجولة أمام HUL على ملعبه. مباراة أرسنال تقدم فرصة نموذجية للخروج بنظافة شباك (Clean Sheet) مسجلة FDR [2].
* **🔴 بيع Barcola ──► 🟢 شراء Rogers (£8.1m | CHE):** 
  * *السبب التكتيكي:* التخلص من Barcola (xP: 2.8) واستبداله بـ Rogers (xP: 4.6) الذي يدخل جدول مباريات سهلاً متتالياً (SUN, LEE, NFO).
* **جدوى الخصم (-4 Hit) على مدار 3 جولات:**
  * الجولة 10 تقدم فارق نقاط متوقعاً إيجابياً مباشر الصنع، وعلى مدار الجولات الثلاث القادمة، يتوقع أن يحصد التنائي (White + Rogers) ما يتجاوز **+14.5 نقطة** مقارنة بالثنائي المباع. هذا الفارق يتجاوز تكلفة السلب (-4) بمراحل ويحقق صافي مكسب تكتيكي مؤكد (+10.5 نقطة صافية).

---

### 4. مبررات شارة القيادة (C) والنائب (VC)
* **الكابتن (C): Tavernier (BOU) [xP: 6.1]**
  * يأتي الاختيار تطبيقاً للقاعدة الذهبية للقيادة؛ لاعب بسعر مثالي (£6.5m) يمتلك جدولاً ممتازاً ومساهمات هجومية عالية وركلات ثابتة. استهدافه ككابتن يوفر ميزة تفاضلية هائلة (Differential Captain) للقفز في الترتيب.
* **النائب (VC): Mbeumo (MUN) [xP: 5.5]**
  * تم اختياره كنائب كابتن لتوفير الأمان الرقمي في حال حدوث أي غياب مفاجئ، نظراً لثبات مشاركته وسقفه التهديفي العالي.

---

### 5. استراتيجية الخواص وحماية ميزانية الفريق
* **السيولة المالية (£6.2m):** إبقاء هذا المبلغ الضخم في البنك ليس هَدراً، بل هو قوة مالية مرنة تتيح لنا مناورة سريعة في الجولات القادمة لجلب أي لاعب سوبر (Premium) بنقرة واحدة دون الحاجة لإعادة هيكلة الفريق.
* **إدارة الخواص (Chips):** الاحتفاظ بكافة الخواص (Wildcard x2, Free Hit, 3xC, Bench Boost) هو القرار الرياضي الصائب بنسبة 100%. القيمة القصوى لهذه الخواص تتضاعف رياضياً خلال جولات الحرمان والجولات المزدوجة (DGWs / BGWs) في النصف الثاني من الموسم.

---

### الخلاصة التنفيذية
إن التشكيل الأساسي للجولة 10 يعكس فلسفة إدارة مخابراتية حاسمة: لا مكان للعواطف ("Points are Points"). التضحية بـ 4 نقاط خصم هي استثمار مدروس بعناية لتحسين معدل Points Per Million وتغطية خط الدفاع بالكامل بأقوى منظومة دفاعية (أرسنال)، مع تكثيف القدرة الهجومية في خط الوسط. نحن نلعب الآن باستراتيجية المخاطرة المحسوبة لاقتحام الترتيب العام بثبات وقوة.

TEAM NEWS | AINA STARTS AGAINST BRENTFORD
press_wire.summary: One change to starting XI Aina returns Listen to the action live on Forest TV Ola Aina returns to the Nottingham Forest starting XI for the fixture against Brentford in the only change from the side that picked up a point against Ipswich Town last time out in the Premier League. The defender takes the place of Daniel Muñoz, who drops to the substitutes’ bench at the Gtech Community Stadium. Dan Ndoye is fit enough to start in west London after Oliver Glasner confirmed the attacker was a doubt for the fixture. However, Nicolás Domínguez misses out on the matchday squad after missing our last Premier League game. Matz Sels keeps up his record of starting every Forest fixture this season behind a back three of Jair Cunha, Nikola Milenković and Murillo. Aina comes into the team at right wing-back, while Neco Williams starts on the left after recovering from injury against the Tractor Boys. Xaver Schlager and James McAtee continue their partnership in the middle of the park, with Ndoye starting alongside the Forest captain, Morgan Gibbs-White, in support of the attack. Liam Delap leads the line. Muñoz is on the Forest bench against the Bees. Supporters can listen to the action live on Forest TV, courtesy of BBC Radio Nottingham’s Colin Fray, from around 2pm GMT. Team news Forest Sels; Jair Cunha, Milenković, Murillo, Aina, Schlager, McAtee, Williams, Ndoye, Gibbs-White (C), Delap. Substitutes: John Victor; Diomande, Sangaré, Hudson-Odoi, Wood, Kalimuendo, Yates, Netz, Muñoz.

Jackson aiming for more versus Fulham
press_wire.summary: Fixtures Aston Villa Vs. Fulham - Sat, Oct 31 2026, 20:00 Nicolas Jackson’s goals have been crucial for Aston Villa in recent weeks, and the striker is determined to keep his fine form going when Fulham come to town. The Senegalese bagged a brace via some clinical finishing against Manchester City last weekend, firing his side to a 2-1 victory in the Premier League. Jackson has scored seven times in 11 games since his summer move from Chelsea, and he wants more for himself and the team going forward. “Hopefully, there’s more to come and I’ll score more goals,” he said. “I’m just trying to play in my best level, helping the team defend and to score as well. “The most important thing is that the team win – that’s the biggest thing for me.” Jackson added: “It was a difficult start to the season. “We had a lot of new players and everything else. We’re just trying to build and to work together, keeping focused game-by-game. “That’s what we’re doing, so that’s the most important thing for us. Hopefully we can win more games.” The 25-year-old has been a great fit for Unai Emery’s team, leading the line with pace and skill, while also displaying a ruthless streak in front of goal. Jackson has settled quickly at Bodymoor Heath and is enjoying every aspect of life as a Villan. “It’s been amazing,” he reflected. “Amazing coach, the place, the players, the dressing room, the team – everything has been fantastic for me. “I’m very happy, and hopefully we can do amazing things together and win a lot of games and trophies.” Fulham are the visitors on Saturday as Villa aim to enjoy another fruitful day on home turf. It’s an opportunity for Jackson and co to continue their climb up the Premier League table, but he knows three points will not come easily against an improving opponent. “It’s a very important game,” he said. “They’re good opponents, a good team. Every game is important to us, so we’ll see how it goes against Fulham. “We’re trying to win every game, respecting the opponent and working hard to win as many games as we are doing.”

Garner On Everton Goal Threat & 'Real Chance' Cup Verdict
press_wire.summary: James Garner believes Everton have a “real chance” of making their mark in the Carabao Cup this season after Thursday night’s excellent 3-1 victory over Newcastle United. Garner was on the scoresheet at Hill Dickinson Stadium, chipping in for his first goal of the season. With the Blues facing League Two’s Fleetwood Town in the quarter-finals of the competition in the next round, he believes the Blues should hold genuine belief they can go all the way in the competition. “It was important for us to get the win and to go into the next round,” Garner told evertontv. “I think if we would have heard at the start of the competition that we’d be in the quarter-finals and facing Fleetwood, we would have taken it. "So, it's a real chance for us to actually do something with this cup. “It would be amazing for us as players, as a team, as a club, and for the fans as well, to hopefully go and bring some silverware back here.” Among the goalscorers on Thursday, Garner hopes to continue building confidence and fitness after overcoming a groin injury at the start of the campaign. “It’s always a good feeling when you score a goal,” he added. “Unfortunately, I don't score enough, which I need to start doing, but to score a goal and to put the team on the front foot is a good feeling. “Good performances and even something small – like a goal – does boost your confidence. I just need to stay positive. “I know I came back really early with my injury – probably a bit too early – but that just shows the type of person I am. “I want to be there for the lads, and that's what I have done. “I'm pushing every single day to be 100 per cent, and I hope everyone can see that.”

press_wire.title: B TEAM CLAIM WIN OVER LUTON IN PREMIER LEAGUE CUP
press_wire.summary: Nottingham Forest B Team claimed a third Premier League Cup group-stage victory over Luton Town after late heroics from Fuad Smith. Forest found themselves two to the good with 15 minutes to go after goals from Archie Whitehall and Smith, but a late fightback from Luton saw them level the scoring in stoppage time. Up stepped Smith in the 93rd minute, however, to steal the three points back and make it 3-2. It was an open and entertaining affair early on, with both sides creating opportunities. Sonny Nolan was inches away from putting the young Reds ahead after a sweeping counter-attack, seeing his first-time effort dribble just wide. Alvin Isufi came close to punishing the missed chance moments later down the other end when he fired wide from range. A flurry of chances came before the break, with Forest pushing to take the lead. Jayden Powell’s clever run was rewarded when he knocked the ball round the goalkeeper but could only find the side netting from a tight angle. Chinaza Nwosu and Blaine McClure also had chances but were unable to really trouble the Luton 'keeper. Just three minutes into the second period, Archie Whitehall got himself on the scoresheet to put Forest ahead. The young Reds looked dangerous on the counter all night and capitalised in the 71st minute, when Fuad Smith raced through on goal before a composed finish just moments after coming off the bench to double his side’s lead. Luton fought back from two down as Dempsey Crace headed home in the 76th minute before finding the equaliser in the 90th minute after a clinical Dawid Gawel finish. Super-sub Smith stole the glory just three minutes later, snatching the three points in the most dramatic fashion, taking advantage of an error at the back and slotting home coolly. The young Reds return to Premier League Cup action next month, where they will welcome Newcastle United on 18 November.
